title: slimmer-item-details
description: Update the details pane (in both the TUI and web UI) to have collapsible show/hide sections. Title and description are always visible. History is expanded by default. All other sections (plan, impl_spec, test_spec, impl_notes, etc.) default to collapsed. Empty sections are shown but collapsed rather than hidden. State does not persist across sessions.
plan:
## Implementation Plan: Collapsible Sections for Item Details

### Overview
Implement collapsible show/hide sections in both TUI and web UI details panes. Only Title and Description are always visible. History is expanded by default. All other sections default to collapsed. Empty sections are shown but collapsed. State does not persist.

### Sections to Implement

**TUI (pipeline/tui.py):**
- Title (always visible)
- Description (always visible)
- History (expanded by default)
- Plan (collapsed default)
- impl_spec (collapsed default)
- test_spec (collapsed default)
- impl_notes (collapsed default)
- Questions for Human (collapsed default)
- Pipeline Log (NOT included - confirmed by human as only "actual Item Details")

**Web UI (server/templates/client.html):**
- Title (always visible)
- Stage, Board, Created, ID (always visible - these are header fields like Title)
- Description (always visible)
- History (expanded by default)
- Questions: Show as collapsible when stage !== 'requested-input', render inline (as-is) when stage === 'requested-input'
- Available Actions (collapsed default)

### Technical Implementation

#### TUI Implementation
1. Replace Markdown widget with Textual's `Collapsible` layout
2. Create a header row with Title (and core fields: Board, Stage, ID) - always visible
3. Description section - always visible
4. For each collapsible section, use Textual's `Collapsible` widget:
   - `Collapsible(title, ...)` where title is the section name
   - Set `collapsed=False` for History, `collapsed=True` for all others
   - Empty sections still render collapsed rather than hidden
5. Ensure keyboard navigation works (Textual handles this natively)
6. Handle long content with scrollable containers inside Collapsible

#### Web UI Implementation
1. In `toggleFeatureDetail()` function, restructure the HTML:
2. Keep core fields (Title, Stage, Board, Created, ID) always visible in header
3. Always-visible Description section
4. Use `<details>` and `<summary>` elements for collapsible sections:
   - `<details open>` for History (default expanded)
   - `<details>` for Plan, Questions (conditional), Available Actions
   - Empty sections still render as `<details>` (collapsed)
5. Style with CSS for consistent look
6. Add `aria-expanded` attributes for accessibility

### Naming Conventions
Use exact field names from code:
- `impl_spec` (not "Implementation Spec")
- `test_spec` (not "Test Spec")
- `impl_notes` (not "Implementation Notes")
- `plan`
- `history`
- `description`

### Accessibility Considerations
- TUI: Textual's Collapsible provides keyboard support (Enter/Space to toggle)
- Web UI: Use `<details>`/`<summary>` which have native accessibility, add `aria-expanded`
- Focus management when toggling sections

### Edge Cases
- Very long content: Use `max-height` with `overflow-y: auto` in web UI; use `VerticalScroll` in TUI
- Empty sections: Render collapsed `<details>` or `Collapsible` but do not hide entirely
- Questions form in web UI: Conditionally wrap in collapsible based on stage !== 'requested-input'
